answer.rationale: P99 latency spike to 5x target correlates directly with a release 2 hours ago. This is the most direct causal signal. Memory_b1 confirms that rollback cleared a similar checkout error spike without customer impact. Memory_b6 validates that staged gating catches regressions, suggesting this release may have an undetected issue. Given we have one intervention slot and settlement peak traffic (heavy writes), rolling back to the stable prior build minimizes write path risk immediately. Regional failover would not address a code regression. Capacity adds are too slow for this degradation pattern. Circuit breaker and read replica routing do not resolve write path latency when the issue is likely in application logic. Rollback is lowest-risk and highest-probability recovery path.
